subject: Data description entry
notes: SR18 states the SAME permitted list as SR17, and keeping them as two hand-maintained chains is how they drifted apart (SR18 had fifteen flags to SR17's ten, both still short of ALIGNED, GROUP-USAGE, SELECT WHEN and the validation clauses). ONE constant now serves both rules. The written set also retired the hasGlobal / hasProperty locals, which existed only because GLOBAL and PROPERTY bind post-build and so escaped an allowlist keyed on decode flags. kb/Work PB487.
